description: Use-case shortlists for Theme Discovery step 1. Popular flagship sets sort first in Studio/MCP discovery UX. Each entry is a ready 3-theme set — preview all three with preview_themes, then lock meta.theme. After locking, set craft knobs (ratio/emphasis/bento/code filename) — Studio exposes the same controls.
